thread:
maya_sales: OrionPay requested a CompetitorX -> Redwood POC next Tue. They need: 1) prompt/stop-token parity for streaming clients, 2) token-billing reconciliation, 3) rate-limit mapping (they currently see 10k rps bursts), and 4) completed security questionnaire. Who owns what? cc @zach_se @nina_se

zach_se: I can lead tech presales + parity harness. Ask them for sample payloads and exact streaming framing.

maya_sales: Uploaded samples and SQ link to Confluence (ORION-POC). They use `session_id` header and expect identical chunk boundaries.

ben_solutions: I'll prepare a proxy shim (header mapping + NDJSON chunking) and a curl demo. Example: `{map_headers:{"x-client-session":"session_id"},stream_mode:"ndjson"}`.

nina_se: I'll own SQ responses. Need to confirm retention, KMS, and dedicated/no-retention options. Default POC retention = 30d; 0-day available on Dedicated with LDA.

ada_pm: For billing parity we can't promise identical token counts. Offer: run reconciliation during POC, produce a delta report, and remediation if delta > 5%.

zach_se: Parity SLO proposal: "<=1% response-fidelity regression on customer evals during migration month". I'll run smoke tests (stop-token edge cases, repeated delimiters, truncated context) and share by Fri.

security_bot: SQ checklist: SOC2, TLS, RBAC, audit logs, KMS/HSM, retention options. Docs: https://security.redwood.ai/sq

maya_sales: Timeline: POC doc by Fri EOD, SQ answers Thu, parity smoke by Fri, demo Tue. Owners: Zach (parity), Nina (SQ), Ben (proxy). Confirm?

zach_se: Confirmed.

nina_se: Confirmed.

ben_solutions: Confirmed. I'll attach Docker compose and curl scripts.

maya_sales: Great  I'll update the customer and send invites.
